camel_example: aliyun ons OnsInstanceCreate --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName '测试实例'
description_en: Call the OnsInstanceCreate operation to create an instance
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-instance-create --instance-name '测试实例' --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsInstanceCreate

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

The instance name must be unique in the region where the instance is deployed.

The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。取值说明如下：
实例名称在该实例所部署的地域下要唯一，不可重名。

长度限制为3~64个字符，可以是中文、英文、数字、短划线（-）以及下划线（_）
parameters.name: instance_name

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the created instance

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the created instance. Valid value:

1: standard instance
InstanceType.description_zh:
创建的实例类型，取值说明如下：

1：标准版实例

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is unique to each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
